source.description:
PROBLEM: The amendment requires the fleet below the XTRM statusline through a footer-section seam, never aboveEditor. The specialists side registers through globalThis.__registerFooterSection when present (unitAI-beqby.4) but falls back to setWidget with belowEditor placement, which renders above the editor and competes with the footer. The core custom-footer section API lives in the other repo, so the specialists side cannot finish this alone.

SUCCESS: With the seam present the fleet renders as a footer section below the statusline with no setWidget call (already covered by test); the seam-absent fallback behavior is settled per operator decision recorded in notes (keep the belowEditor fallback or hide until the seam is present). No aboveEditor placement anywhere. The cross-repo core item is referenced, not owned.

SCOPE: Specialists repo only: the fleet paint and fallback block in config/pi-extensions/specialist-subagents/index.mjs plus seam tests. No core repo changes.

NON_GOALS: Core custom-footer implementation (other repo, plbug chain); row, hint, or telemetry wording; inspector work.

CONSTRAINTS: custom-footer remains the sole setFooter owner; the fleet never calls setFooter or setStatus. Suite green, tsc clean. Every dispatch under unitAI-beqby passes model_override opencode-go/muse-spark-1.3-contributor.

VALIDATION: Unit tests for seam-present (section registered, no setWidget) and seam-absent fallback behavior; operator live check that the fleet sits below the statusline, recorded in notes.

OUTPUT: Commit on a specialists branch, core follow-up link and operator decision recorded in bead notes.

SCRUTINY: low
source.title: Fleet placement remainder: belowEditor fallback versus footer-section seam (acceptance 1-2)
